review_synthesis.reading_contract_zh: 评审先读一个空间总纲、三处差异化原型和一个后台治理内核，再按六项任务核对证据，最后只把现实缺口交给专业团队；不按轮次数量评价方案。
review_synthesis.reading_contract_en: Review one spatial master grammar, three differentiated prototypes, and one back-stage governance kernel first; then test the six taskbook duties against evidence and hand only real-world gaps to professionals. Do not score the proposal by round count.

regional_synergy_retest_matrix.purpose_zh: 把五个区域协同节点的建议角色、输入边界、复测输出和停止条件写成可替换的交接合同；不证明合作、责任接受、场地、预算或现实结果。
regional_synergy_retest_matrix.purpose_en: Turn five proposed regional relay nodes into replaceable handoff contracts with role, input boundary, retest output, and stop condition; this proves no partnership, accepted duty, site, budget, or real-world result.
regional_synergy_retest_matrix.shared_input_boundary: task_id, versioned protocol, anonymized aggregate, and failure record only; no raw sensitive data or cross-region authorization claim
regional_synergy_retest_matrix.shared_gate: written acceptance + approved scope + ordinary-task field baseline + data safety + stop/recovery record + independent retest; otherwise G0 / NO-GO

records.role: everyday-service and community-co-creation reference for Origin Community
records.input: consented task description, non-identifying protocol version, aggregate thresholds
records.retest_output: same-task completion, abandonment, staffed handoff, withdrawal, and correction receipt
records.stop_condition: non-AI route breaks or lengthens; screen-free entry, withdrawal, or handoff fails

records.role: offline or shadow retest for basic science and frontier equipment
records.input: test protocol, equipment class, anonymized failure class
records.retest_output: versioned technical result, failure cause, return-to-G0 decision pack
records.stop_condition: stale or conflicting source, missing safety duty, or ordinary task affected

records.role: reproducibility check related to scientific facilities
records.input: protocol, synthetic or authorized aggregates, retest prerequisites
records.retest_output: independent retest summary, deviation register, stop/recovery recommendation
records.stop_condition: facility condition, approval scope, data safety, or professional duty missing

records.role: engineering retest for manufacturing, robotics, and embodied systems
records.input: interface contract, anonymized performance band, failure class
records.retest_output: engineering retest pack, fault isolation, staffed takeover, place-return conclusion
records.stop_condition: unclear safety boundary, failed takeover, affected ordinary movement, or no independent retest

records.role: cross-regional protocol, source, and ordinary-service-parity check
records.input: task/protocol version, anonymized result, failure record
records.retest_output: replicability difference table, local gaps, retain-NO-GO recommendation
records.stop_condition: rules, sources, rights, ordinary path, or accountability cannot align
